# Mehdi Salimi

> Portfolio of Mehdi Salimi, a software engineer building responsive dashboards and interactive web applications.

Mehdi Salimi works with JavaScript, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and related frontend tools.

## Portfolio

- [Mehdi Salimi Portfolio](https://mehdisalimi.com/): Canonical profile, skills, work experience, and project index.

## Selected Projects

- [Nobino](https://nobino.ir): Project at Armaghan Talaie using Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, and MUI.
- [SmartComm](https://smartcomm.ir): Project at Armaghan Talaie using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MUI, Zod, and Zustand.
- [Hillter Hotel](https://salimidev.github.io/Hotel-ReactJsApp): Freelance project using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Tesla Clone](https://salimidev.github.io/TESLA-CLONE): Freelance project using React, Redux, and styled-components.
- [PaydarCrane](https://paydarcrane.ir): Industrial crane services website.
- Business intelligence (BI): Project at PAYA using React, PrimeReact, Highcharts, and Tailwind CSS.
